titles.romaji: Benghuai: Xingqiong Tiedao - Yilun Zhaoyang de Mingyun
titles.english: Honkai: Star Rail  — The Destiny of Each New Dawn
titles.native: 崩坏：星穹铁道 一轮朝阳的命运

description:
Darkest night falls as the sun sets in the west, only to rise again in the east. Such is the destiny of each new dawn.

(Source: Honkai Star Rail YouTube Channel)
